title: Alternative protein first-pass delta
shortVerdict: Created a Norway-first CAR-006 registry delta for alternative protein, insects, mycoprotein, seaweed inputs and circular feed R&D.
strongestSource: Actor-primary pages for Pronofa, NorInsect, Invertapro, BIO3, Seaweed Solutions, Arctic Seaweed and Norwegian Seaweed Cluster plus Brreg API checks
weakestPoint: The batch does not yet close capacity, realized-volume, customer or full dedupe questions.
gapType: Type A for source/dedupe follow-up; Type B for actor-scale details
ikkeSi: Do not treat planned capacity as realized production.
Do not count project rows as producer capacity.
Do not infer food/feed end-use for seaweed actors without actor-specific source.

title: Founder/key-person handling
shortVerdict: Only NorInsect founder/key-person data was imported because it was available on an actor-primary source.
weakestPoint: NoMy, Invertapro and other people/ownership details found in secondary sources were not imported.
ikkeSi: Do not import founders from secondary startup press.
Do not add private contact details.
Do not treat investor quotes as founder proof.

title: Project rows are context not producer capacity
shortVerdict: MultiFuelLarve, Millennial Salmon and Algae2Insect were retained as project/context rows to map the innovation system without inflating producer coverage.
strongestSource: NIBIO, Nofima and Moreforsking project pages
weakestPoint: Project participants and commercial follow-on actors need later extraction.
ikkeSi: Do not double-count consortium rows as companies.
Do not infer commercial production from project objectives.
Do not present project outcomes as current market adoption without result sources.
